protocol.input_confirmed_by_user: same simulated noglass 1 cm cloud for both methods
protocol.depth_units: mm integer camera Z; not radial range
protocol.error_aggregation: pool all eligible pixels/points over 10 views, not mean of per-view means
protocol.point_error: one-sided Euclidean NN from every saved float32 backprojected PLY point to original noglass 1cm cloud; no ICP
protocol.depth_error: saved decoded PNG camera Z minus independent unnormalized-ray no-glass mesh first-hit camera Z
protocol.common_mask: A depth alpha>=0.5 AND B occupied AND mesh reference valid
protocol.occlusion_proxy: signed depth difference >30 mm behind or <-30 mm in front of mesh first hit; boundary sampling can contribute
protocol.interior: 3x3 mesh-depth range<=30mm and complete valid 3x3 neighborhood
